claim.quote: The combined results yield a contour minimum of \sigma_{p} = 4.2 x 10^-3 pb at 35 GeV/c^2 on the spin-dependent sector of WIMP-proton interactions, the most restrictive to date from a direct search experiment

name: Final Analysis and Results of the Phase II SIMPLE Dark Matter Search
notes: Date: the latest arXiv version (v3, 9 Apr 2012), whose abstract is quoted; the arXiv comment on it reads 'revised, PRL-accepted version with slightly weakened limit contours', so the first submission (v1, 15 Jun 2011) is not the version quoted.

summary.plain: SIMPLE's final Phase II result (two stages of 15 detectors): the most restrictive spin-dependent WIMP-proton limit from a direct search at the time, according to the paper.
summary.technical: Two run stages of 15 SDDs, the second with improved neutron shielding; revised nucleation efficiency. Contour minima: sigma_p(SD) = 4.2e-3 pb and sigma_p(SI) = 3.6e-6 pb at 35 GeV/c^2. Published as Phys. Rev. Lett. 108, 201302 (2012).

title: Final Analysis and Results of the Phase II SIMPLE Dark Matter Search
why_it_matters: The abstract says the result overlaps for the first time results previously obtained only indirectly. The data were re-analysed in the 2014 paper (arXiv:1404.4309).
